# Aegon Builds Business-Critical Multicloud Architecture with Aviatrix on AWS

AEGON

Over several decades, Aegon has established itself 
as a leading integrated, diversified, international 
financial services group. In that time, its 
infrastructure evolved along with it, growing 
unsustainably complex. Aegon found itself 
managing legacy architecture while investing in 
cloud and then multicloud as the result of 
acquisitions and the varying needs of its 
business units.

"I used to tell the team, it's like we're operating a 
Baskin-Robbins of infrastructure, which you can 
imagine quickly becomes costly and doesn't allow 
us to manage standardization where appropriate," 
said Glynis Coutee, Head of Infrastructure 
at Aegon.

Aegon needed greater agility, scalability, and faster 
go-to-market, yet found that operating in a single 
cloud was not an option. To manage its multicloud 
environment, it needed an automated solution that 
could effectively connect the Amazon Virtual 
Private Clouds (VPCs) and Azure Virtual Networks 
(VNETS) in its environment and manage encryption 
- all without adding headcount or complexity. It was 
clear that building and maintaining such a solution 
using internal resources was not an option.

## Achieving Network Agility and Scalability

After deploying Aviatrix, Aegon saw value almost 
immediately as it was able to improve agility and 
implement automation. IT can now partner with the 
company's business units to understand needs and 
deliver truly impactful outcomes for the customer. 
Aegon can also spin up network tunnels in just 3-4 
clicks. What used to take hours to deliver, now 
takes seconds.

Aegon has also increased its ability to scale without 
significant investment in headcount for multicloud 
support. Leveraging rich APIs that Aviatrix already 
had in place, Aegon avoided building much of the 
automation that it needed to support its connectivity. Aviatrix has also delivered the increased 
visibility the company needed to inspect traffic 
and secure its network.
